description: Signup (track B). Retention exception 2 of the no-delete rule: an unverified signup, which holds no patient data, is hard-deleted after seven days by the signup.purge pass of the worker.

sql.why: Retention exception 2: app.signup_purge removes an organization that was never confirmed (status unverified, older than the cutoff and never younger than a day) with its pending signup, links, job markers and audit trail, and writes signup.purged in the platform trail. Only the fixed list of tables is deleted: any other row that points at the organization (a member, a patient, a key) stops it with a foreign key violation, so it can never take clinical data or a verified organization. The application role has no DELETE on any of these tables; it can only run this function.

Retention exception 2, unchanged: the same function app.signup_purge, replaced to count the organizations it could not remove (purge_attempts) and work the ones with fewer failures first, so rows that fail with a foreign key violation do not starve the newer ones. It deletes the same fixed list of tables for an organization nobody confirmed; nothing about what it may delete changed.
